# Library of Congress

> The world's largest library with 162M+ items, offering digital collections, research resources, educational materials, and public services through its comprehensive catalog and discovery platforms.

The Library of Congress serves as the research library for the United States Congress and provides access to millions of digitized items including books, manuscripts, photographs, maps, films, and audio recordings. The institution operates multiple specialized research centers and preservation facilities while offering educational programs, reference services, and community engagement initiatives.

## Discovery & Collections

- [Library of Congress Catalog](https://catalog.loc.gov): Primary search interface for 20M+ catalog records across all collection types
- [Discover the Library of Congress](https://www.loc.gov/discover): Main discovery portal for searching millions of digitized items across formats
- [Home | Library of Congress](https://www.loc.gov): Homepage for Library of Congress, world's largest library with 162M+ items

## Research & Reference Services

- [Use the Library | Research Centers](https://www.loc.gov/research-centers/use-the-library): Guide to using Library resources and accessing specialized research centers
- [Ask a Librarian](https://ask.loc.gov): Reference service for asking librarians research questions and accessing guides
- [Help Resources](https://www.loc.gov/help): Help resources covering catalog searches, reference assistance, and accessibility

## Education & Learning

- [Education Resources from the Library of Congress](https://www.loc.gov/education): Educational materials and primary sources for teachers and students
- [Teacher Resources](https://www.loc.gov/teachers): Teacher resources, primary source analysis tools, and classroom materials

## About & Services

- [About the Library of Congress](https://www.loc.gov/about): Institutional overview covering organizational structure and major services
- [Services & Programs](https://www.loc.gov/services-and-programs): Overview of Library services, cataloging standards, preservation, and tools

## Visitor & Community Engagement

- [Visiting the Library](https://www.loc.gov/visit): Visitor information for Thomas Jefferson Building and Packard Campus locations
- [Connect with the Library of Congress](https://www.loc.gov/connect): Social media channels, blogs, podcasts, and community engagement resources
- [Contact the Library of Congress](https://www.loc.gov/contact): Contact information and phone directory for Library departments and services
- [Library of Congress Blogs](https://blogs.loc.gov): Blog platform featuring stories about collections, history, and cultural content

## Optional

- [Support the Library of Congress](https://www.loc.gov/programs/support-the-library-of-congress/about-this-program): Donation programs and ways to support the Library of Congress
- [Lost 19th Century Film by Méliès Discovery](https://blogs.loc.gov/loc/2026/02/lost-19th-century-film-by-melies-discovered-at-the-library): Blog post about discovery of lost 1897 Méliès film and film preservation work
